image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a sliced bagel sandwich. The top half of the bagel is prominent, showing a golden-brown crust with small dark specks (likely poppy seeds or burnt flour). A slice of pale green cheese (possibly avocado-flavored or herb cream cheese) and a layer of smoked salmon are visible between the halves. The bagel rests on a white napkin atop a plate with blue and red stripes. A finger is partially visible in the top left corner holding the bagel.

The boundary between the top crust and the filling on the left side appears slightly fused or blurred, lacking a crisp separation line expected in a sliced sandwich.
The striped pattern on the plate rim shows slight waviness inconsistent with a rigid ceramic plate, suggesting minor geometric warping.
